description: This file defines the 'Delete' feature for handling removal of article favorites in the ASP.NET Core application. It includes command validation and a request handler that interacts with the database context to delete a favorite article based on the article's slug and current user.

classes.name: Delete
classes.description: Contains the command for deleting an article favorite and the request handler for executing the deletion.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the request command with the article slug, implementing IRequest<ArticleEnvelope>.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the request to delete a favorite article, performing database operations within an async method.

methods.name: CommandValidator
methods.description: Constructor defining validation rules for the Command.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the deletion of the favorite article and returns the updated article envelope.
